tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL Proteus mirabilis, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
